schema: p800-fp16-interface-audit-review-v1
title: P800 厂商 FP16 接口、eager 调用与实际算术精度核实结果

reading_guide.overview: 先看summary、confirmed_findings和remaining；interfaces包含范围内清单，device_images包含机器码结论，runtime_comparisons包含调用来源。
reading_guide.unknowns: pending/unresolved不表示不支持，也不允许自动改成FP32。
reading_guide.runtime_origin: eager_operator_reference为历史算子测试的eager参考调用；direct_sdk为直接SDK探针。代码一致不证明公开主机API相同。
reading_guide.scope_denominator: 清单包含待归类的泛型、配置和依赖项，不能用已测试签名数除以清单总数作为完成率。

scope.reference: 原始未舍入FP32输入和权重

summary.overall_completion_reason: 完整FP16动态计算路径分母和逐接口精度证明尚未完成。
summary.runtime_signature_count_limitation: 历史总体计数包含拒绝和部分观察；不当作115个已完成FP16算术证明。
summary.word_roundtrip_percent_scope: 仅限已收集的1363份镜像，不是接口验证或全目标完成率。
summary.exact_fp16_host_instances_scope: 此前两库统计保留在exact_fp16_host_instances；旧适配库新增的逐函数链接结果另列legacy_fp16_typed_exports。

archived_launch_index.scope: 索引指向runtime_comparisons中的[用例,发射]；同镜像哈希可以出现在不同设备入口或提供库，索引本身不证明调用了某个公共宿主接口。

fp16_interface_coverage.scope: Unique SDK declarations. Covered requires a typed FP16-involving device execution in at least one configuration. Rejection-only, historical FP32-only, static paths, and model-image matches alone are excluded. The explicit subset requires FP16 in the declaration or a linked specialization with concrete FP16 signature. Neither denominator is the count of all possible FP16 compute paths.

confirmed_findings.conclusion: 已测最大池化反向存在add.hf.rn，重叠梯度逐次FP16累加与直接SDK和厂商FP16 eager一致；同输入FP32累加末尾转换结果不同。
confirmed_findings.scope: 限已归档形状、配置、版本和输入；不推广所有池化实现。

details.limitation: This finite output fits the displayed half accumulation order; not a proof of every dynamic reduction schedule.
This finite output fits the displayed half accumulation order; not a proof of every dynamic reduction schedule.

confirmed_findings.conclusion: 直接SDK NCHW FP16 batch_norm_stats的已测路径出现半精度平方/局部累加溢出；同组PyTorch eager使用不同镜像且未出现该错误。
confirmed_findings.scope: 不能将直接SDK问题归到eager；仅限固定SDK与已测配置。

confirmed_findings.conclusion: 39份静态镜像中观察到967个显式FP16算术或比较机器字，实际分支执行和完整算术仍待核实。
旋转位置编码正反向的4份新镜像出现96个显式FP16算术字，包括vmul.hf.mz.rn；即便其中系数参数为FP32，也不能假定内部全部按FP32计算。
新增广播计算相关tensor_calc镜像出现显式FP16比较；其中8份镜像还出现合计10个vadd.hf.mz.rn。不能把这些实现概括为只有FP16搬运/转换，或全部使用FP32算术。
confirmed_findings.limitations: 这些镜像通过静态调用链发现。调用参数、选路条件、立即数的用途和算术块实际执行仍待核实，不能将所有相关API一律判为FP16算术。

confirmed_findings.conclusion: 补回DNN/BLAS XPU3命名空间后，calc_basic和common_calc_mn1_m1k_unalign两份FP16镜像确认24条vadd.hf.mz.rn；逐字重汇编与原代码一致。
confirmed_findings.limitations: 未证明具体调用输入会执行这些指令，也未解明SDNN协处理内部算术；本批未运行加速卡。

confirmed_findings.conclusion: 补齐fast_silu栈索引和两张内部表后，条件性Context3路径关联到一份2824字节SDNN镜像。706字中682字可重汇编还原，24字未解决；出现EW查表、系数、DS/DMA配置和dsmul。
confirmed_findings.limitations: 没有显式半精度助记符不能证明全FP32。静态解码本身不证明执行；后续实卡对应关系单列fast_silu_sdnn_runtime_vs_eager。查表内容、协处理内部精度及舍入仍待核实，未授权FP32提升。

confirmed_findings.conclusion: 第二台物理0卡的24组直接SDK/FP16与FP32比较完成，424332元素独立复核。FP16直接fast_silu使用12Cluster×8Core的SDNN镜像，eager SiLU使用12Cluster×64Core的不同Cluster镜像；不能混同为同一实现。12组FP32全部通过原始FP32门槛；FP16与eager最大差异1.9073486328125e-6，正式FP16验收仍未定。
confirmed_findings.limitations: 只覆盖4个长度、3种有限输入、默认Context和空max指针。内部查表/算术、其他参数与形状、非有限输入及整模型路径仍未证明，未授权新的全FP32转换。

confirmed_findings.conclusion: 493个实测FP16输入中，19个输入的SDK与eager结果不同，全部位于−20至−8。对这493个输入，eager结果均与数学SiLU仅在末尾舍入为FP16的结果一致。9个输入在SDK上输出负零，数学参考保留非零次正规数。
confirmed_findings.scope: 原始实测输入与空max参数下的诊断。查表单元内部精度仍待核实。

confirmed_findings.conclusion: xblasGemmEx 在已测 16×32×64、FP16 输入和输出、compute_type=64 的用例发射含模式 37 的镜像。64.0625²−4104 的实测结果为 1/256，逐乘积先舍入至 FP16 再求和会得到 0。
confirmed_findings.scope: 实际乘法器和累加器位宽仍待验证，整模型是否使用相同接口取决于具体调用。

confirmed_findings.conclusion: 在16×64实测输入上，按四条交错通道及相邻配对建模，SUM和MEAN各自穷举32768种逐加法舍入安排，前14次都需表现为FP16最近偶数舍入。在原始样例上末级仍有两种解释；新增MEAN有限输入已单独区分，见sdnn_mean_final_merge。
confirmed_findings.scope: 限已测输入和给定归约顺序；物理算术位宽、其他布局、eager调用和整模型均须另证。

confirmed_findings.conclusion: 48组公共XDNN和FP16 eager归约的有序发射一致，5428个结果逐位相同。这些样例均使用Cluster镜像；实测结果也等于同一组已存为FP16的输入用FP32 eager计算再末次转换。
confirmed_findings.scope: The public reduction probes and SDNN probe have different shapes. Device images and resource identities separate the implementations. Matching outputs on a sample and the presence of FP32 instructions do not establish whole-operator arithmetic or a whole-model route.

confirmed_findings.conclusion: 7种alpha=2调用原被判全FP32，修复后均保留原语义；5种单位系数对照的分类保持一致。
confirmed_findings.scope: 本项为个人Docker CPU图改写；设备结果另见scaled_add_live_fma。整模型影响待测。

confirmed_findings.conclusion: 在固定版本适配库中，已把张量和标量加法的4个宿主特化及其调用位置与确切动态导出对应。FP16张量路径可下调至接收float系数的旧命名空间add_tensor，也有mul_scalar和add_scalar调用位置。
confirmed_findings.scope: 宿主调用为静态证据。已测调用的实发机器码与数值见scaled_add_live_fma；其他分支仍待核实。单独的公共DNN加法在此版本走不支持入口。

confirmed_findings.conclusion: 8个已跑P800的缩放对照共66304元素。保留FP32乘法系数、两次eager运算间写回FP16的模型逐位吻合；把系数先存FP16会多出11086处差异，仅取消中间写回会多出3671处差异。公共融合scale在这些输入上符合一次末端舍入。
confirmed_findings.scope: Full raw-output comparisons on archived finite inputs. The .7 factor multiplies data in a separate eager operation. Models test coefficient rounding and intermediate stores, not physical multiplier width or tensor-add alpha.

confirmed_findings.conclusion: 已按库、符号、入口、发射类型和代码哈希对上5489条实发记录，涉及49个对照算子标签和73份镜像。ReLU的6次发射落在带显式半精度指令的镜像。每次发射在核内执行了哪些分支仍需单独证明。
confirmed_findings.scope: Indices identify archived eager launches and their static device bytes. A comparison label can cover multiple operators. Neither a specific host API call nor individual branch execution follows from a matching image.

confirmed_findings.conclusion: 厂商适配库将标量和张量上下限分别送往 clamp<float16> 与 clamp_tensor<float16>。FP16 双标量 eager 的机器码含半精度最大/最小值。INSTRUCTOR-base 的12份整模型eager捕获合计288次发射张量basic镜像，其可见分支包含FP32最大/最小值及双向转换。FP32标量镜像在102个模型实际发射，比较循环使用FP32。另有固定输入实卡对照，详见minmax_live_device_comparison；历史整模型的上下限具体取值仍未知。
confirmed_findings.scope: Successful locally retained model eager captures with verified binaries, ordered launch indices, raw log and receipt; multiple trials per model. Tensor shapes, bound values, frontend overload, host invocation and executed lanes are not recorded by the launch interposer.

confirmed_findings.conclusion: FP16单侧clamp有44个无穷输入在厂商eager中返回有符号65504，升位再比较后为有符号无穷。两侧、行广播和转置等控制按用例留存。
10组有限输入、7种调用形式的16670个元素均与FP32 fmaf后转FP16逐位相等。将FP32乘法、加法分开舍入有1667个元素不同。
86个模型的247份完整eager记录与4个已安装归约入口的机器码精确匹配。FP16模式5见于58个模型、179次发射。固定适配库的linalg_vector_norm和reduce_L2均可静态到达同一描述符。指令含FP16输入转FP32、FP32乘加和写回FP16。
confirmed_findings.scope: 输入形状、宿主调用及每条指令的执行未由整模型发射日志记录，尚不能据此提升整图。

confirmed_findings.conclusion: 在16×64非零输入均为FP16正规数且无溢出的样例中，低层SDNN均值的64个输出全部符合末次先舍入FP16再缩放，FP32末次合并有24处不同。另一组仅4列全负零对应的符号不符。eager同形状走Cluster，128个独立输出位置中有48个与SDNN不同。
confirmed_findings.scope: 给定四路归约顺序、样例和测试过的模型。不能外推SUM末次舍入、零符号形成阶段或其他形状。

confirmed_findings.conclusion: 同卡vector_norm的64、384、768列均命中历史整模型相同入口。96个FP16/FP32输出均与按输出类型正确舍入参考相同，48个FP16输出中12个排除每次平方写回FP16，15个排除平方和先写回FP16。
confirmed_findings.scope: 限定16行、非负范数、ord=2和最后一维归约；内部所有分支与其他阶数仍未完全解码。

routing_policy.unknown: 保留原语义，不根据输入输出dtype或未见半精度指令进行提升
routing_policy.scaled_fp16_add: 已测FP16张量的带系数加法与FP32系数、FP32融合乘加和最终写回FP16逐位一致。保留原精度边界，只有能复现乘加舍入和写回合同的候选才可扩展。
routing_policy.minmax: 纯标量单侧和双侧clamp与ReLU按实际比较精度分流，FP16进入混合搜索，FP32进入FP32搜索。张量上下限保留原语义；单侧FP16需保留按原始dtype构造的缺省边界。

arithmetic_assessment.actual_dispatch_arithmetic: Finite BatchNorm/InstanceNorm typed execution and raw state diagnostics. The SDK and PyTorch adapter use different kernels for some FP16 statistics; NCHW half square/accumulation instructions are byte-verified, with zero-rstd high-bias counterexamples to final-round FP32 equivalence. NHWC inference/InstanceNorm reject before launch; elemt has no layout flag and the tested byte layout matches NCHW. FP32 NHWC BN and some InstanceNorm controls fail the unchanged FP32 reference gate. Partial failed runs are retained separately. Subsequent original-input FP32 statistics-only interventions remove all 44715 forward/gradient failures. The six separate statistics failures (65 elements) share bit-identical statistics with paired training calls. NHWC BN needs rstd replacement; InstanceNorm can require both mean and rstd. This is finite numerical evidence, not a production patch or a full arithmetic-precision proof.

arithmetic_assessment.actual_dispatch_arithmetic: Finite BatchNorm/InstanceNorm typed execution and raw state diagnostics. The SDK and PyTorch adapter use different kernels for some FP16 statistics; NCHW half square/accumulation instructions are byte-verified, with zero-rstd high-bias counterexamples to final-round FP32 equivalence. NHWC inference/InstanceNorm reject before launch; elemt has no layout flag and the tested byte layout matches NCHW. FP32 NHWC BN and some InstanceNorm controls fail the unchanged FP32 reference gate. Partial failed runs are retained separately. Subsequent original-input FP32 statistics-only interventions remove all 44715 forward/gradient failures. The six separate statistics failures (65 elements) share bit-identical statistics with paired training calls. NHWC BN needs rstd replacement; InstanceNorm can require both mean and rstd. This is finite numerical evidence, not a production patch or a full arithmetic-precision proof.

remaining.detail: FP16泛型、运行时dtype选择和依赖接口尚未完全归类，完整计算路径分母未确定。 已在46组范围内声明中找到173个同签名多定义族，共661处定义位置；运行时身份需按具体特化和调用绑定。

39个旧未闭合入口现有1185条深层静态调用见证，关联267个设备入口；调用参数、条件/错误分支和实际选路未证明。仍有117个深层终点受深度/节点/FDE边界限制、764处间接目标未解析；这不替代全部1864个主机实例的核实。 重新扫描1864个函数后共231个函数/238张有界表，176个函数的183个选择器有条件性Context来源证明，55个选择器仍未证明；新增16个设备编号3分支已记录，但设备实现与运行条件仍需继续追踪。 新增16个分支现已关联103个设备入口，具备382条静态调用/描述符见证。修正审计工具遗漏xpudnn_xpu3/xblas_xpu3命名空间；本批仍有261个深度终点、2个FDE边界、2054处间接目标未解析，7个全局/XCN入口设备代际未知。分支可行性、参数传播、动态绑定与实际选路仍未证明。 后续补齐fast_silu两个内部表及栈零扩展索引的保存/恢复，在标准operator new分配契约假设下新增1个条件性Context证明；合计177函数/184选择器，余54选择器未证明。动态分配符号绑定、实际运行路径和算术仍待核实。 fast_silu本批12个FP16有限输入已观察到对应SDNN镜像；这不证明所有分支可达、动态导入绑定或每条协处理指令的内部精度。 旧适配库1375个已核实特化中，317个宿主入口直接连到386个XPU3设备描述符。继续核对其中的325个内部包装后，合计627个宿主特化可经直接控制流到达设备入口。817个额外描述符含间接跳转后的候选。具体输入对应的分支与运行时绑定尚待核实。 另核对12个具名归约包装、77个可达设备入口。11个FP16宿主特化中10个找到设备路径。
1350份镜像仍有未解决机器字；静态指令出现不证明实际分支执行，也不证明整个接口的算术精度。
需按具体模式核实乘法、累加、系数、输出舍入及协处理单元，不能只由dtype或模式名称推断。 已测MEAN有限正规输入能区分末级舍入；SUM末级、全负零的符号形成位置仍待查。
当前对应关系来自历史算子测试，不能替代CLIP336/MiniLM等整模型的实际路径和形状条件。 已核实105个历史模型中927次min/max相关eager发射；每次运行的具体算术和全模型融合影响仍待复测。 归约族另有86个历史模型、247份记录的2294次实发精确匹配。两类统计可能覆盖相同模型。
已在第二台物理0卡完成fast_silu的24组直接SDK及72次eager控制；12次FP16直接调用命中新增SDNN镜像，eager使用不同Cluster镜像。其他接口/形状及整模型复测仍待完成。 第四台完成clamp等96组、带系数加法70组厂商eager设备控制。仍待SDNN分段归约及更多输入合同。
本地框架已限制带系数加法的升位。发布包v64及整模型尚待复测。 张量clamp和单侧缺省边界已加守卫。非单位alpha需要可复现FMA的正式生成路径；完整模型待复测。
FP16正式验收门槛由用户确定，当前未自行设定。

boundaries: 原始厂商源码和二进制字节仍留个人Docker；本文件保存派生结论、符号、哈希和指令文本。
本次JSON汇总不会修改生产SDK、正式F06或精度门槛；不会把历史算子测试当作新设备运行。

sdnn_ew_compile_evidence.scope: Compile-only controls with symbolic addresses, two pinned header trees and the stated template, layout and mode. No device execution or arithmetic inference.

callee_evidence.scope: Each call was compiled again with an isolated C++ namespace in a joint translation unit; its AST declaration identifier matches the body identifier in that invocation. The original individually compiled source and final image are linked by hash. No runtime selection implied.

declaration.name: ew_reduce
declaration.qual_type: void (typename ndarray_trait<UNISRAM_2D, T>::TV *, typename ndarray_trait<UNISRAM_2D, T>::TV *, int, int, EW_ACTIVATION_TYPE)

sdnn_ew_reduction_stage_analysis.scope: Last compact-output 16x64 SDNN direct SDK run on finite stored inputs. The column order is fixed to the previously matched four interleaved lane chains and adjacent pair merges. operations uses homogeneous lanes; heterogeneous_lane_checks allows each individual addition its own precision. Other schedules, internal physical width, non-RNE behavior and model dispatch remain unproven.
sdnn_ew_reduction_stage_analysis.writeback: binary16 RNE after reduction and mean scaling

sdnn_measured_pointwise.unknown_dispatch_policy: Preserve native semantics; do not assume a model operator uses this overload

public_reductions_vs_sdnn.evidence: The public reduction probes and SDNN probe have different shapes. Device images and resource identities separate the implementations. Matching outputs on a sample and the presence of FP32 instructions do not establish whole-operator arithmetic or a whole-model route.

pending_sdnn_mean_input_fixture.scope: Four competing stage models on this tile. Expected predictions are not P800 output. A matching model need not identify unique hardware, and other scaling/overflow policies remain possible.

pending_sdnn_mean_finite_inputs.units: All nonzero inputs are exactly representable finite normal FP16. Zero fills the other lanes. No partial sum reaches overflow; output subnormal handling has separate predictions.
pending_sdnn_mean_finite_inputs.scope: Conditional discriminator using the four-interleaved-lane order; no measured device outputs.

public_entry_availability.scope: Fixed-version strict link and CPU static observations. Runtime reachability, device arithmetic and full model performance of scaled eager add remain unverified.

legacy_fp16_typed_exports.scope: Fixed installed legacy adapter DSO, exact type/relocation/strict link. No API execution and no arithmetic conclusion.

legacy_eager_launch_index.scope: Indices identify archived eager launches and their static device bytes. A comparison label can cover multiple operators. Neither a specific host API call nor individual branch execution follows from a matching image.

legacy_host_launch_index.scope: Static direct transfer displacements, ELF/FDE extents and descriptor argument verified. Conditional host branches, call returns, indirects and ELF interposition preclude concluding that a particular public export ran. A shared descriptor proves the kernel identity only.

legacy_wrapper_launch_index.scope: A direct or table-conditioned CFG call remains possible, without proof of concrete input predicate, interposition, or per-instruction execution.

scaled_add.scalar_scope: The historical .7 and 1-2^-11 values are scalar multiplication coefficients; the separate scalar addend was -1. They do not test nonunit alpha in torch.add(a,b,alpha=...).

legacy_f06_scale_fx_validation.scope: CPU tests exercise F06 graph classification, region widening, original-source binding, and output cast separately against historical P800 outputs. The reviewed SDK gate was supplied as an experiment control. No new P800 graph run, latency, model precision acceptance or general promotion.

legacy_scale_coefficient_replay.scope: Full raw-output comparisons on archived finite inputs. The .7 factor multiplies data in a separate eager operation. Models test coefficient rounding and intermediate stores, not physical multiplier width or tensor-add alpha.

minmax_live_device_comparison.scope: Actual signed-zero and nonfinite inputs included. Original FP32 eager and same-storage FP32 eager on the same P800 are separate per-element controls. CPU output differences are diagnostic. Static word observations lack per-lane tracing. Numeric model admission and speed were not measured.

scaled_add_live_fma.scope: Only the captured finite FP16 operands and FP32 coefficients. Fused multiply-add consistent across these cases. This is not a license to drop alpha, split FMA, or promote untested scalar and layout forms.

minmax_overload_review.scope: Archived P800 runtime and installed SDK host/device code. This component links the Tensor clamp descriptor statically. Separately indexed whole-model eager launches are in minmax-model-machine-validation.json. CPU FX replay observes frontend dispatch, outputs and aliases; it does not measure XPU arithmetic. Equal finite min/max outputs cannot distinguish comparing FP16 operands directly from widening before selection.
